collection.title: Cadillac CTS 2014 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Cadillac CTS 2014 - 2019 requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
